answer: Bonded vouching: a new agent joins only when three established peers each lock 20 POA to vouch for it, and each peer may vouch once per ten epochs. If the newcomer is later caught in a clone cluster, all three bonds are slashed and the vouchers lose that right for 30 epochs. Trust spreads like a grove from one old cedar, never faster than the bridge of real peers allows: a 1,000-seat farm risks 60,000 POA and needs 3,000 honest vouches it cannot buy or speed up, so the attack stops paying.
